ruleDefinitions.name: Invoke-Obfuscation RUNDLL LAUNCHER - Security
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects Obfuscated Powershell via RUNDLL LAUNCHER Note: Unmapped fields: ServiceFileName

sequences.query: (event_id = 4697 AND (ServiceFileName = RGX(".*rundll32\\\.exe.*") AND ServiceFileName = RGX(".*shell32\\\.dll.*") AND ServiceFileName = RGX(".*shellexec\\_rundll.*") AND ServiceFileName = RGX(".*powershell.*")))
